metadata.name: mkdocs
metadata.description: Project documentation with Markdown — fast, simple, and beautiful (with Material theme by default)

installScript: if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages mkdocs-material || python3 -m pip install mkdocs-material; else python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --user mkdocs-material || python3 -m pip install --user mkdocs-material; fi

if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages mkdocs || python3 -m pip install mkdocs; else python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --user mkdocs || python3 -m pip install --user mkdocs; fi

pipx.description: MkDocs Material installed via pipx (isolated environment)

aiPrompts.versionDiscovery: MkDocs and mkdocs-material are distributed via PyPI. Check https://pypi.org/project/mkdocs/ and https://pypi.org/project/mkdocs-material/ for latest versions.
aiPrompts.updateGuidance: MkDocs follows semantic versioning. The Material theme depends on MkDocs and tracks its releases. Installing mkdocs-material pulls mkdocs as a transitive dependency.
